method: Read on 1 November 2026 from GitHub's own web pages (each account's repositories page, 30 a page, and each sampled repository's page) in a signed-in person's browser, read only, with no API token and no third-party feed. GitHub's own repository count was matched for every account. Repositories that only members of an enterprise or organisation can see (internal or private) were left out of every count and list here.

reread.nw-gmsa: GitHub showed 9 repositories when the counts were checked, against 8 read earlier the same day; the account was read again and its new repository added

sample.method: Stratified random sample of live (not archived), non-fork public repositories: each sector gets 400 shared in proportion to its live repositories, at least 15 (or all, if fewer), drawn by sorting each sector's repositories by name and shuffling with a seeded generator (mulberry32). Tabs read from each repository's page on GitHub.
